mapper.select: -- Select pre-signup candidate count and support amount range without storing personal input. SELECT count(1) AS possible_candidate_count, min(a.min_amount) AS min_support_amount, max(a.max_amount) AS max_support_amount FROM announcements a WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' AND (a.application_start_date IS NULL OR a.application_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (a.application_end_date IS NULL OR a.application_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) AND ( #{regionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_region_required WHERE aoc_region_required.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_region_required.condition_key IN ('REGION_CODE', 'WORKPLACE_REGION_CODE') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_region WHERE aoc_region.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_region.condition_key IN ('REGION_CODE', 'WORKPLACE_REGION_CODE') AND aoc_region.option_code = #{regionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) AND ( #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc_revenue_required WHERE anc_revenue_required.announcement_id = a.id AND anc_revenue_required.condition_key = 'ANNUAL_REVENUE' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc_revenue WHERE anc_revenue.announcement_id = a.id AND anc_revenue.condition_key = 'ANNUAL_REVENUE' AND ( (anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'GTE' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} >= anc_revenue.value_number) OR (anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'LTE' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} <= anc_revenue.value_number) OR (anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'GT' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} > anc_revenue.value_number) OR (anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'LT' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} < anc_revenue.value_number) OR (anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'EQ' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} = anc_revenue.value_number) OR ( anc_revenue.comparator_code = 'BETWEEN' AND #{annualRevenue,jdbcType=NUMERIC} BETWEEN anc_revenue.min_number AND anc_revenue.max_number ) ) ) ) AND ( #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc_years_required WHERE anc_years_required.announcement_id = a.id AND anc_years_required.condition_key = 'BUSINESS_YEARS' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc_years WHERE anc_years.announcement_id = a.id AND anc_years.condition_key = 'BUSINESS_YEARS' AND ( (anc_years.comparator_code = 'GTE' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} >= anc_years.value_number) OR (anc_years.comparator_code = 'LTE' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} <= anc_years.value_number) OR (anc_years.comparator_code = 'GT' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} > anc_years.value_number) OR (anc_years.comparator_code = 'LT' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} < anc_years.value_number) OR (anc_years.comparator_code = 'EQ' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} = anc_years.value_number) OR ( anc_years.comparator_code = 'BETWEEN' AND #{businessYears,jdbcType=NUMERIC} BETWEEN anc_years.min_number AND anc_years.max_number ) ) ) ) AND ( #{hasSpouseCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_spouse_required WHERE aoc_spouse_required.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_spouse_required.condition_key = 'HAS_SPOUSE' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_spouse WHERE aoc_spouse.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_spouse.condition_key = 'HAS_SPOUSE' AND aoc_spouse.option_code = #{hasSpouseCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) AND ( #{hasChildCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_child_required WHERE aoc_child_required.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_child_required.condition_key = 'HAS_CHILD' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc_child WHERE aoc_child.announcement_id = a.id AND aoc_child.condition_key = 'HAS_CHILD' AND aoc_child.option_code = #{hasChildCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) )
